suite: 3D pane follows the selection (sweep, bind, reload, hover)
expect_red: [real] a reload reopens the pane the reader left open, at the width they left it

mutations.contract: A pane left open reopens after a reload.
mutations.note: The stored flag is written correctly and nothing reads it at boot -- the round-trip test of the storage pair passes over exactly this. A second mutation (clamping the stored width at boot) was retired (2026-10-28, the_kinematic_study_reads_like_every_other_study_and_its_plot_shows_both_tolerances): it showed only while the preview pane stood down for the scene, so a width chosen with the pane hidden could exceed the boot layout's room. The pane never stands down now, so the width a reader chooses is already clamped against that room and the boot clamp returns it unchanged -- the mutation no longer describes an observable defect.
